factor_scores.evidence_summary: Threshold-reduction/timelock-removal monitoring is applicable to 2-of-3 Guardian/TSS, but changes are not publicly evented or independently verifiable.

factor_scores.evidence_detail: The absence of any public bounty means there is no scoped reward path for the largest Unit treasury/bridge surfaces.
factor_scores.evidence_summary: No public bounty exists, so the highest-TVL bridge/treasury surface has no public bounty scope coverage.

factor_scores.evidence_detail: No named external integrator, team contributor persona, attributed deposit campaign, or social-engineering credibility build-up surfaced in public Unit sources. This M-only factor remains gray without a curator/provider flag.
factor_scores.evidence_summary: No curator-flagged persona with >=$1M credibility deposits was found.

sources.reference: Public searches found no Unit-specific real-capital social-engineering persona; no curator/provider flag available.

factor_scores.evidence_detail: The security page states endpoints are rate-limited and Guardians can pause operations if malicious activity is detected. Parameters, per-window limits, trigger authority, and restart process were not disclosed.
factor_scores.evidence_summary: Unit documents rate-limited endpoints and Guardian circuit-breaker policies that can pause operations, but does not publish caps, windows, or emergency procedures.
